source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 558 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 558.

PD 558.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 558 was established by Ordinance No. 24039, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 22, 1999. Ordinance No. 24039 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 558 is established on property fronting on the south line of Spring Valley Road, beginning at a point approximately 1,188.72 feet east of the east line of Hughes Lane. The size of PD 558 is approximately 8.7494 acres. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 558A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control.

(b) An amendment to a development plan only requires the approval of the city plan commission. All development plans and their amendments must comply with this article. If the commission disapproves an amendment to the development plan, the applicant may appeal the decision to the city council. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Private streets.

(b) Except as provided in Subsection (a), the uses permitted in this district are all uses permitted in the R-1/2ac(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R- 1/2ac(A) Single Family District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the R-1/2ac(A) Single Family District by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this planned development district only by SUP. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R- 1/2ac(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this planned development district; etc. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory heliport or helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard.

(1) For single family uses, no minimum front yard.

(2) For all other permitted uses, minimum front yard is 10 feet.

(b) Side and rear yard.

(1) For single family uses, no minimum side and rear yard.

(2) For all other permitted uses, minimum side and rear yard is 20 feet.

(c) Dwelling unit density. Maximum number of dwelling units is 16.

(d) Floor area. No maximum floor area.

(e) Height.

(1) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. (See Section 51A–4.412.) Exception: Except for chimneys, structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less. Chimneys may project through the slope to a height 12 feet above the slope and 12 feet above the maximum structure height.

(2) Maximum height. Unless further restricted under Paragraph (1), maximum structure height is 36 feet. For residential structures, maximum height is measured to the highest point of the roof.

(f) Stories. Maximum number of stories is two.

(g) Lot coverage.

(1) Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent for residential structures.

(2) Maximum lot coverage is 25 percent for nonresidential structures.

(3) Surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not included in lot coverage calculations.

(4) Eighty percent of an individual lot may be covered by structures if the coverage for the Property does not exceed 60 percent and at least 40 percent is reserved for open space.

(h) Lot size.

(1) Minimum lot area is 2,000 square feet for residential structures.

(2) For all other uses, minimum lot area is one-half acre. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Sidewalks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.108. SIDEWALKS.

Sidewalks are not required. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. In this district, off-street parking must be provided at or below ground level.

(b) A parking space must be 13 feet from the right-of-way line adjacent to a street or alley if the space is located in an enclosed structure and if the space faces upon or can be entered directly from the street or alley.

(c) A parking island may be located within the cul-de-sac as shown on the development plan, subject to department of public works and transportation approval of design standards. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Floodplain
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.110. FLOODPLAIN.

See Article V. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Ingress-Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.112. INGRESS-EGRESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Site Improvements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.113. OFF-SITE IMPROVEMENTS.

Subject to approval by the department of public works and transportation of design standards, the following off-site improvements must be provided prior to the issuance of any building permit on the Property:

(1) A median opening at Spring Valley Road must be provided.

(2) A deceleration lane at Spring Valley Road must be provided for ingress into the private street.

(3) An acceleration lane at the private street must be provided for egress onto Spring Valley Road. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.114. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Foundation wall planting, ground cover, and at least four trees which are 4-6 caliper inches must be provided in the "landscape area" identified on the development plan.

(c) Tree preservation and mitigation of tree removal must comply with Article X.

(d) All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Security Gate
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.115. SECURITY GATE.

All security gates for vehicular access must be located at least 25 feet from a public right-of-way. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Walls
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.116. WALLS.

A solid eight-foot-high wall must be constructed along the north side of Lot 1 and Lot 16, as shown on the development plan, prior to issuance of a building permit for any residential structure. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.117. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.118. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-558.119. ZONING MAP.

PD 558 is located on Zoning Map No. C-7. (Ord. Nos. 24039; 25163)
